notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in your graveyard.
Klauth has power 5 or greater, or you control another creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Klauth, or any other creature you may need to attack with.
description:
Declare Klauth and any other creature, if needed, as an attacker.
Klauth triggers, adding at least {4}{R/W}{R/W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, Kirri triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding a land card, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
